verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail / Virtual Mail documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and static API-key authentication. That supports non-interactive, scriptable automation without the web UI, which is the core of running headlessly. The docs, however, say nothing about CI use and explicitly lack a sandbox or test mode, so automation runs against the production account. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, a sandbox/test environment for CI, CI-specific documentation, and hands-on corroboration of headless pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Your API key is tied to your user account, so it can reach every mailbox you have access to.
The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is available as a YAML file for import into tools like Postman, Swagger UI, or code generators.
Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use
